result.instructions: Tools for Bookster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings arrive this weekend, and which are still unpaid?"; "Show me the availability of the Old Farmhouse for next month."; "What is the cheapest 3-night stay for 4 people in March?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bookster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bookster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bookster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bookster_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bookster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bookster_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest booked first by default. Filter by property, state, arrival, departure, a night the stay covers, customer name or email, booking reference, or last update. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/bookings.json.

sort.description: Sort order. Default created.desc (newest booked first).

property_id.description: Only bookings for this property (from bookster_list_properties).

covers_date.description: Stays that cover this night (arrive before, leave after).

updated_on.description: Compare the last-updated date with this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_comparison.description: How updated_on compares: e on the day (default), g after, l before, ge on or after, le on or before, n not on the day.

tools.name: bookster_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking with its customer details, party, dates, value and balance, the lines (extras and products), and housekeeping notes. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/bookings/{id}.json.

tools.name: bookster_list_booking_tags
tools.title: List booking tags
tools.description: List the tags on one booking as a map of tag name to value. Tags are the keys your own integration sets. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/bookings/{id}/tag.json.

tools.name: bookster_set_booking_tags
tools.title: Set booking tags
tools.description: Add, update or delete tags on one booking. Each key is a tag name: a new name adds the tag, an existing name with a non-empty value updates it, and an existing name with an empty value deletes it. Use CamelCase names with your own prefix. Changes the booking record in Bookster. Bookster API: PUT /system/api/v1/booking/bookings/{id}/tag.json.

tags.description: Map of tag name to value. An empty value deletes that tag.

tools.name: bookster_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List properties (rental units, caravan pitches, rooms and similar) in the account, with their id, type id and name. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/entry/entries.json.

tags.description: Only properties that have this tag.

client_id.description: Only properties owned by this client id.

tools.name: bookster_get_property
tools.title: Get a property
tools.description: Get one property with its elements: address, facilities, descriptions, geo location, local authority and more. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/entry/entries/{id}.json.

tools.name: bookster_get_availability
tools.title: Get property availability
tools.description: Get the availability ranges of one property: each range has a start, an end (exclusive) and an available flag. Only single-product setups are supported. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/query/{id}/availability.json.

syndicate_id.description: Optional booking source (syndicate) id for the check.

tools.name: bookster_get_length_of_stay_prices
tools.title: Get length-of-stay prices
tools.description: Get the prices for every possible stay of one property for the next 18 months (up to 30 nights). Each returned string is CSV: date, party size, then the price for 1, 2, 3... nights. A zero price means that stay is not possible. Prices are in the property's currency, rounded to whole units. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/query/{id}/los.json.

syndicate_id.description: Optional booking source (syndicate) id for the prices.

tools.name: bookster_get_booking_setup_state
tools.title: Get booking setup state
tools.description: Get whether online booking is enabled, disabled or sold out for one property, and the state of its last consolidation (the job that publishes setup changes). Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/setup/{id}/state.json.

tools.name: bookster_get_booking_setup_document
tools.title: Get a booking setup document
tools.description: Download one booking setup document of a property: rates, availability, extras, products, payment profiles, reservation profiles, legals, bundles, provider, or applicability rules. Returns the name and the document JSON as text. latest=true returns the newest document that is not yet consolidated. Bookster API: GET /system/api/v1/booking/setup/{id}/ir.json.

latest.description: true: the newest, possibly not yet consolidated, document. Default: the active one.
